exposure: history of at least one previous cesarean delivery
severity of striae gravidarum (Davey scoring system)
cohort: 100 pregnant women with a history of at least one previous cesarean delivery
finding: Preoperative evaluation of striae gravidarum severity and extent, particularly in upper quadrants, is a feasible option to predict IPA risk in patients with repeated CD.
mod_finding: The study focuses on predicting intraperitoneal adhesion risk in pregnant women with a history of cesarean delivery and doesn't directly relate findings to mode of delivery in the current pregnancy.
